comment.body: Thanks for identifying the Apple Studio Display. PowerDisplay relies on Windows DDC/CI or supported WMI paths; a display can be visible without exposing a control interface this module can use. Could you confirm whether Windows Settings lists it, how it is connected, and whether Windows itself offers brightness control? This distinguishes discovery from unsupported control; no new logs are needed.
